subject.title: [Bug]: Extension plugins silently skipped by gateway loader in v5.3+ (loads in CLI process, not in long-running daemon)

question: Should maintainers repair and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78229, replace it with a narrower equivalent fix, or intentionally keep the activation-metadata requirement?
rationale: The issue is a source-proven regression with security impact, but the current candidate fix changes the Gateway native plugin startup boundary and needs explicit maintainer handling before merge.

options.title: Repair or replace the linked fix
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers land a corrected startup-planner fix with daemon proof and opt-out/security-boundary coverage.

options.title: Accept the metadata-only contract
options.body: Keep the runtime behavior and close only after maintainers explicitly decide that legacy enabled-only hook plugins must add activation metadata or hook policy config.

options.title: Defer to docs only
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and rely on the broader docs issue, accepting that existing legacy installs remain broken until manually migrated.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the linked fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers land a corrected startup-planner fix with daemon proof and opt-out/security-boundary coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the hook startup planner behavior and regression coverage that the fix must adjust.
